title: verification-result
description: The verifier stage's verdict. The coordinator routes the workflow on status and retry_recommended, so both are required.

status.description: The verdict the coordinator routes on.

severity.description: How badly the finding blocks acceptance.

location.description: File or area the finding applies to.

required_behavior.description: What must be true for the finding to clear.

unverified.description: What could not be verified, and why.

retry_recommended.description: Whether the coordinator should route a bounded retry.
